l1_words.meaning: current, up to date (it does NOT mean 'actual')

pattern_explanation: Several Turkish words look almost identical to English words because both languages borrowed them from the same international sources. The similar spelling does not guarantee the same meaning, so learners should check the meaning before translating word by word.
false_friend_warning: Warning: the Turkish word 'pasta' looks like the English word 'pasta', but it means cake. A learner who uses it to mean noodles will choose the wrong word.
